scope: Finite review work queue for all mandatory named requirements and RV64I; not an exhaustive normative clause inventory or architectural proof

open_items.topic: Review instruction/data access atomicity and RVWMO rules against the actual platform paths.

resolved_items.topic: Map ECALL/EBREAK and defined illegal instruction metadata to the base clauses.
resolved_items.disposition: Base ECALL/EBREAK and defined illegal metadata mapped to decode/head completion, precise ROB/CSR trap delivery and non-retirement. A same-ELF five-mode 100-case delegation matrix checks original EPC/tval, counter deltas and preserved values, complementing the existing breakpoint GVA/return matrix. Memory atomicity and RVWMO remain under base.2.

resolved_items.topic: Complete current-target reserved encoding and zero-destination disposition.
resolved_items.disposition: Current-target OP/OP-32 M encoding partitions and rd=x0 destination suppression reviewed through decoder cleanup. Native 13-form zero-destination cases and 36 reserved-word precise traps complement the existing independent arithmetic results; active-flush ownership is reviewed separately under muldiv.2.

resolved_items.topic: Connect multiply/divide issue, recovery and retirement ownership to the instruction contracts.
resolved_items.disposition: Issue/data/tag binding, selective/full wrap-aware flush, live-result arbitration, matching ROB completion and architectural rename commit reviewed in the production source. New XLEN64 active/held ownership component scenarios complement the existing production RV64 issue/execute/retire witnesses; no universal schedule claim.

open_items.topic: Map access-fault, misalignment and permission priority for LR, SC and AMO.
Document the constrained-loop progress argument under the platform arbitration assumptions.

resolved_items.topic: Review the exclusive read-modify-write retry path against interfering accepted writes.
resolved_items.disposition: Exclusive read/write retry reviewed through engine old-value recomputation, ID/address/size monitors, accepted-write invalidation, failed-exclusive no-write and serialized successful target ownership. A production-component AXI interference matrix covers 270 cases and 243 failed attempts; whole-core AMO value and drain evidence remain complementary. Fault priority and constrained progress stay open.

resolved_items.topic: Close the hint decode and no-memory-request argument in the current target.
resolved_items.disposition: Ignored NTL/prefetch use rd=x0 integer paths without LSU, CSR or CBO classification; PAUSE uses the existing FENCE drain path. Current-target decode, extension overrides and head classification reviewed with the cited snapshot/Sail evidence.

resolved_items.topic: Separate architectural hint behavior from optional microarchitectural actions and timing.
resolved_items.disposition: The specifications permit ignoring NTL/prefetch and permit PAUSE to wait for outstanding memory completion. Optional cache allocation, power and performance effects are separated from architectural state and the independent Zkt/Zvkt timing evidence.

resolved_items.topic: Review FENCE.I ordering from older accepted stores to future instruction fetch.
resolved_items.disposition: FENCE.I reaches completion only after older committed stores receive responses and LSU accepted traffic/translations drain. Serializing ROB and head ownership preserve the explicit-memory boundary; source and native self-modifying execution reviewed.

resolved_items.topic: Connect resident/refilling I-cache and frontend invalidation completion to retirement.
resolved_items.disposition: The I-fabric idle input is constant, so correctness uses retire-driven invalidate, killed refills that cannot install valid tags, retained response epochs, and architectural frontend redirect/target-buffer invalidation. Both source priority rules and current race/self-modifying execution evidence reviewed.
